text:
Ana Morales: quick ask — need a small bundle of benchmark assets for next week's webinar + launch posts. goal: 1) one hero benchmark tile (latency vs cost narrative), 2) two micro-tiles for social, 3) a slide template for the webinar deck that includes a data callout and routing CTA to our inbound flow. brand + accessibility required. timeline: first drafts by Weds EOD.
Lina Chen: on it. can you confirm the primary metric set? latency p95, tokens/sec, and cost/token? or do you want throughput (req/s) instead of tokens/sec?
Mike Patel: include latency (p50/p95), throughput (tokens/sec), and cost/token. We need a tiny table that shows sample unit economics for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. I'll paste numbers in a sec.
Samir Desai: copy notes — headline should read: "Serving wins: lower cost, predictable latency". subhead: one sentence about workload types (chat vs batch). Also want a version with no claim (legal prefers conservative language) for APAC channels.
Kate Rivera: brand heads-up: use Approved Blue #0A6CF0 for primary accent, logo lockups must follow the clearspace rules in the Brand Kit. Contrast target AA for body, AAA for small text where feasible. For the hero tile, avoid gradients that break the suggested logo overlay.
Design-Bot: template generated: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/micro-benchflow-template — contains hero, micro-tiles, slide master. export settings (for designers):
```
export: png@2x for social, 1200x630 hero; 1080x1080 micro-tile; slide master: 1920x1080, left gutter 96px
format: PNG with sRGB profile, max filesize 1.5MB
alt text: short description per image (we'll pair with copy in the doc)
```
Lina Chen: thanks! a couple clarifications: 1) should hero include comparative bars or a line sparkline? 2) do we want a tiny infographic showing caching/batching effect?
Ana Morales: go with comparative bars for hero (easy to scan) + an optional micro infographic tile that shows "cache + batching = lower cost" as a small 1:1. keep copy short.
Jordan Lee: for inbound routing: the CTA on slide should map to the webinar form -> lead routing tag "bench_webinar_2026" and set funnel param utm_campaign=bench_launch. Ops — can we get the routing doc updated?
Mike Patel: pasted numbers (use these as sample labels on the tile): Hosted: p95=320ms, tokens/sec=150, cost/token=$0.0009. Dedicated: p95=180ms, tokens/sec=420, cost/token=$0.0006. Private: p95=210ms, tokens/sec=380, cost/token=$0.0005. use Hosted as baseline.
Lina Chen: perfect. I'll mock bars and a small callout for p95. Samir — will include the conservative language variant as a layer.
Samir Desai: also request a 1-line metadata strip for the hero (model used, seq len, test harness link). legal wants test harness link hidden behind a disclosure modal on the page but visible on the slide as "see notes".
Kate Rivera: accessibility reminder — color contrast check for the green callout (cost delta) and ensure the iconography uses the accessible stroke weight. Also provide SVGs for logos and icons and a flattened PNG for hero export.
Lina Chen: timeline check — I'll post first Figma frames by Tues EOB, final exports by Thurs noon. who owns QA?
Ana Morales: marketing will QA for messaging; design to run visual QA (contrast + bleed). Jordan to update routing doc once assets are uploaded.
Design-Bot: created PRD checklist: [x] Figma frames, [ ] alt text doc, [ ] export assets, [ ] routing update. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/bench-asset-prd
Jordan Lee: I can own routing update. please ping me when final assets live and include a csv mapping of CTAs -> tags.
Mike Patel: small ask for webinar slide: add a data callout box with "sample query latency" and a code snippet we can paste in the notes. Lina — can you reserve a small fixed-width area (300x150px) for code?
Lina Chen: yep. will include a dark-mode variant of the slide master too.
Ana Morales: thank you team — please use thread to post Figma links & quick screenshots for review. if any blockers, call out asap. :art: :rocket: 
Kate Rivera: noted. will review the final assets for brand compliance Tues night. :eyes:
Samir Desai: tagging localization — I'll need the APAC conservative copy by Thurs AM so we can hand to translation.
Lina Chen: adding a note in the file: "Layer: conservative_copy" and "Layer: motion_opt" for a small Lottie-friendly frame.
Design-Bot: upload stub assets to /s3/bench/webinar/stubs/5182509999.zip (permissions: marketing-team).
Ana Morales: awesome. last: please make a 1-slide social-friendly variant that works as the keynote visual on LinkedIn. keep messaging tight.
Jordan Lee: added to routing doc. pinged growth to pre-seed the form.
Ana Morales: closing the loop — thanks everyone, check back Tues for Figma link.
Lina Chen: first frames posted: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/frame-1 — feedback welcome.
Mike Patel: left comments on the Figma — two micro-copy tweaks.
Kate Rivera: visual pass complete — a couple color swaps, updated logo usage. see comments.
Samir Desai: conservative copy uploaded to the doc.
Ana Morales: received — marking as in-progress. final QA Thurs.
